'''Damyean Da'Kethe Dotson''' (born May 6, 1994) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Saga Ballooners]] of the Japanese [[B.League]]. Dotson previously has played for the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] and the [[New York Knicks]] in the [[National Basketball Association]]. He played college basketball for [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]] and [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston]] before being selected with the 44th pick of the [[2017 NBA draft]] by the Knicks.

==College career==
He played two seasons for the [[University of Oregon]]. After his sophomore season, he and teammates [[Dominic Artis]] and Brandon Austin were dismissed due to sexual assault allegations. No one was ever charged due to a lack of evidence and conflicting statements made by the victim.<ref name="Pac–12 Networks">{{cite news |date=May 9, 2014 |title=Damyean Dotson, Dominic Artis, Brandon Austin dismissed by Oregon Ducks |url=http://pac-12.com/article/2014/05/09/damyean-dotson-dominic-artis-brandon-austin-dismissed-oregon-ducks |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140512214231/http://pac-12.com/article/2014/05/09/damyean-dotson-dominic-artis-brandon-austin-dismissed-oregon-ducks |archive-date=May 12, 2014 |access-date=May 9, 2014 |publisher=Pac-12 Networks}}</ref> He subsequently enrolled at [[Houston Community College]] where he did not play basketball but took [[anger management]] courses with [[John Lucas II]].<ref name="brazil">{{cite news |last=Braziller |first=Zach |date=16 September 2017 |title=After heinous allegations, does Knicks rookie deserve this 2nd chance? |url=https://nypost.com/2017/09/16/damyean-dotsons-quest-for-redemption-comes-to-knicks/ |access-date=11 February 2018 |work=[[New York Post]]}}</ref>

He transferred to the [[University of Houston]]. As a senior, he averaged 17.4 points and 6.9 rebounds per game and was named to the First Team [[American Athletic Conference]].<ref>{{cite news |last=Duarte |first=Joseph |date=April 29, 2017 |title=UH guard Damyean Dotson invited to NBA combine |url=http://www.chron.com/sports/cougars/article/UH-guard-Damyean-Dotson-invited-to-NBA-combine-11109078.php |access-date=June 22, 2017 |work=[[Houston Chronicle]]}}</ref>

==Professional career==

===New York Knicks (2017–2020)===
[[File:Damyean Dotson (cropped).jpg|thumb|right|Dotson with the New York Knicks in 2018]]
On August 7, 2017, Dotson signed with the Knicks<ref>{{cite web |last=Ballow |first=Jonah |date=August 17, 2017 |title=Knicks Sign Damyean Dotson |url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/knicks-sign-damyean-dotson |access-date=February 25, 2025 |work=NBA.com}}</ref> and during his rookie season, he received multiple assignments to the [[Westchester Knicks]] of the [[NBA G League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2017–2018 New York Knicks Transactions History |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/nba/teams/New-York-Knicks/20/Transaction_History/2018 |access-date=April 15, 2018 |work=RealGM.com}}</ref> On November 29, Dotson became the eleventh player in history to play in the G League and NBA in the same day.<ref>{{cite news |date=November 30, 2017 |title=Damyean Dotson Plays For Both Westchester and New York Knicks In Single Day |url=https://www.facebook.com/nbagleague/posts/westchester-knicks-in-the-am-new-york-knicks-at-night-damyean-dotson-becomes-the/10155663674080289/ |access-date=February 25, 2025 |work=facebook.com}}</ref> On April 6, 2018, Dotson scored a career-high 30 points and a career high 11 rebounds in a 122–98 win off the bench against the [[Miami Heat]].<ref>{{cite web |date=April 6, 2018 |title=Rookie Dotson scores 30, Knicks blow out Heat 122–98 |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/400975932 |access-date=April 28, 2018 |work=ESPN.com}}</ref>

===Cleveland Cavaliers (2020–2021)===
On November 25, 2020, Dotson signed with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Damyean Dotson to Multi-Year Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/dotson-signing-201125|website=NBA.com|date=November 25, 2020|access-date=November 25, 2020}}</ref> On September 10, 2021, Dotson was waived by the Cavaliers.<ref>{{cite web|first=Marla|last=Ridenour|title=Cleveland Cavaliers sign Denzel Valentine to two-year deal, waive Damyean Dotson|url=https://www.beaconjournal.com/story/sports/pro/cavs/2021/09/10/cleveland-cavaliers-waive-damyean-dotson-after-signing-kevin-pangos/8281804002/|website=Akron Beacon Journal|date=September 10, 2021|access-date=September 16, 2021}}</ref>

===Austin Spurs (2021)===
On October 14, 2021, Dotson was signed by the [[San Antonio Spurs]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Amico |first=Sam |date=October 14, 2021 |title=Spurs Sign Damyean Dotson, Jordan Burns |url=https://hoopswire.com/spurs-sign-damyean-dotson-jordan-burns/ |access-date=October 29, 2021 |website=HoopsWire.com}}</ref> However, he was waived two days later<ref>{{cite web|first=Arthur|last=Hill|title=Spurs Waive Damyean Dotson, Jordan Burns|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/10/spurs-signing-damyean-dotson.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 14, 2021|access-date=October 31, 2021}}</ref> and joined their G League affiliate, the [[Austin Spurs]] on October 27.<ref>{{cite tweet |number=1453389119367925764 |user=austin_spurs |title=Our 2021–22 training camp roster is set! |author=Austin Spurs |date=October 27, 2021 |access-date=October 31, 2021}}</ref> In 12 games, he averaged 12.9 points, 5.6 rebounds and 3.9 assists over 34.9 minutes per game.<ref name="NYK10d">{{cite web |date=December 21, 2021 |title=Knicks Sign Damyean Dotson to a 10-Day Contract |url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/front-office-news/knicks-sign-damyean-dotson-10-day-contract |access-date=December 21, 2021 |website=NBA.com}}</ref>

=== New York Knicks (2021–2022) ===
On December 21, 2021, Dotson was signed by the [[New York Knicks]]. Dotson was signed on a ten-day deal, via New York's 'hardship' exception.<ref name="NYK10d"/><ref>{{cite news|first=Greg|last=Joyce|title=Knicks re-sign Damyean Dotson as COVID ravages roster|url=https://nypost.com/2021/12/20/knicks-re-sign-damyean-dotson-as-covid-ravages-roster/|work=[[New York Post]]|date=December 20, 2021|access-date=December 20, 2021}}</ref> He signed a second ten-day contract with the Knicks on December 31.<ref>{{cite web |last=Almo |first=Alder |title=Knicks sign Damyean Dotson, Matt Mooney to second 10-day contracts |url=https://empiresportsmedia.com/new-york-knicks/knicks-sign-damyean-dotson-matt-mooney-to-second-10-day-contracts/ |website=Empire Sports Media |access-date=December 31, 2021 |date=December 31, 2021}}</ref>

=== Return to Austin (2022) ===
On January 11, 2022, Dotson was reacquired by the [[Austin Spurs]].<ref>{{cite web |date=January 11, 2022 |title=2021–22 NBA G League transactions |url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/ |access-date=January 11, 2022 |website=gleague.nba.com}}</ref>

===Gaziantep (2022–2023)===
On June 23, 2022, Dotson signed with [[Gaziantep Basketbol]] of the [[Basketball Super League]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.basketfaul.com/haber?haber=101873|title=NBA'den Gaziantep'e|last=|first=|date=June 23, 2022|website=|publisher=basketfaul|language=tr|access-date=June 23, 2022}}</ref>

===Ningbo Rockets (2023–2024)===
On September 17, 2023, Dotson signed with the [[Ningbo Rockets]] of the [[Chinese Basketball Association]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Skerletic |first=Dario |date=September 17, 2023 |title=Damyean Dotson joins Ningbo Rockets |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/damyean-dotson-joins-ningbo-rockets/ |access-date=September 26, 2023 |website=Sportando}}</ref>

===Nanjing Tongxi Monkey Kings (2024)===
On September 20, 2024, Dotson signed with [[Nanjing Monkey Kings]]. He is the second foreign player on the roster as [[T. J. Leaf]] signed to the team earlier.<ref>{{cite web |title=Damyean Dotson added to the roster of Monkey Kings |url=https://www.asia-basket.com/China/news/892057/Damyean-Dotson-added-to-the-roster-of-Monkey-Kings |access-date=20 September 2024 |website=asia-basket.com}}</ref>

===Petkim Spor (2024–2025)===
On November 18, 2024, Dotson signed with [[Petkim Spor]] of the Turkish [[Basketball Super League]] (BSL).<ref>{{Cite tweet |user=Petkimspor |number=1858420364352627025 |title=Ailemize hoş geldin, Damyean Dotson!}}</ref>
